editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The T2 ≤ 2T1 constraint, the reset-to-1 probability, the [0, 1] vs [1, 0] qubit-order caveat and the note that AerSimulator overrides basis gates all come through correctly. There are two preposition slips with relative clauses: in [37], "quais qubits ele deve ser aplicado" is missing "a", and in [41], "de quais qubits ela age" should read "sobre quais qubits ela age". In [20], "canal de erro CPTP de n-qubits em geral" can be read as "generally" rather than "a general channel". Heading [36] uses the gerund "Adicionando" while every other heading uses the infinitive ("Combinar", "Converter", "Executar").

examples.source: what qubits to apply it to
examples.translation: e quais qubits ele deve ser aplicado
examples.suggested: e a quais qubits ele deve ser aplicado
examples.why: The preposition 'a' required by 'aplicar a' is missing, so the sentence is ungrammatical.

examples.source: regardless of which qubits it acts on
examples.translation: independentemente de quais qubits ela age
examples.suggested: independentemente de sobre quais qubits ela age
examples.why: 'Agir sobre' needs its preposition. Without it the clause reads as a calque.

examples.source: a general n-qubit CPTP error channel
examples.translation: um canal de erro CPTP de n-qubits em geral
examples.suggested: um canal de erro CPTP geral de n qubits
examples.why: 'Em geral' at the end reads as the adverb 'generally', not the adjective 'general' describing the channel.

examples.source: Add errors to a noise model
examples.translation: Adicionando erros a um modelo de ruído
examples.suggested: Adicionar erros a um modelo de ruído
examples.why: This heading uses the gerund while all the other section headings use the infinitive.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The monitoring cadence, the automatic queue pause, the "under two hours per day" figure on Heron and the scheduling caveats in [31]-[33] all match the English. One term is wrong: "quantum limited amplifiers" in [9] became "amplificadores quânticos limitados", which reads as "quantum amplifiers of limited capability" rather than amplifiers that work at the quantum noise limit. There are also a few calques: "em grupos agrupados" in [38] is redundant, "experimentar estabilidade efetiva reduzida" in [32] is an anglicism, and "dependendo do timing" in [33] leaves an English word where Portuguese has one.

examples.source: This includes the operational parameters of our quantum limited amplifiers.
examples.translation: Isso inclui os parâmetros operacionais de nossos amplificadores quânticos limitados.
examples.suggested: Isso inclui os parâmetros operacionais de nossos amplificadores limitados quanticamente (que operam no limite quântico de ruído).
examples.why: 'quantum-limited' means the amplifier works at the quantum noise limit. The PT reads as 'limited quantum amplifiers', which suggests the amplifiers have limited capability.

examples.source: Randomized benchmarking (RB) in batched groups
examples.translation: Randomized benchmarking (RB) em grupos agrupados
examples.suggested: Randomized benchmarking (RB) executado em lotes
examples.why: 'grupos agrupados' is a redundant literal calque of 'batched groups'.

examples.source: the quantum computer may experience reduced effective stability
examples.translation: o computador quântico pode experimentar estabilidade efetiva reduzida
examples.suggested: o computador quântico pode apresentar uma estabilidade efetiva menor
examples.why: Using 'experimentar' for 'experience' is an anglicism. A native technical writer would use 'apresentar'.

examples.source: depending on timing
examples.translation: dependendo do timing
examples.suggested: dependendo do momento em que forem executados
examples.why: This leaves an English word where plain Portuguese works.

editor_note: Faithful, natural Brazilian Portuguese that keeps the key caveats, including the one in [16] ("só pode ver e acessar as instâncias que foram criadas na região em que você está conectado"), and uses consistent terms (jobs, chave de API, instâncias, ambiente Python confiável) with casual "você" throughout.

The meaning holds throughout. The open-source caveat in [12], the Open Plan restriction on sessions in [8] and the plan eligibility in [28] all come through intact. The problems are small ones a native editor would fix. The product's grammatical gender changes: it is "O IBM Quantum Platform" in [14]/[15]/[16] but "da IBM Quantum Platform" in [28]. In [14], "Projetado para suportar… a plataforma" has a gender-agreement error and calques "support" as "suportar". Also, "abstracted services" in [24] becomes "serviços abstratos", which loses the sense of services that hide the complexity from the user, and the product name "Open Plan" is translated to "Plano Aberto" in [8].

examples.source: Designed to support teams ranging from individual researchers to enterprise-scale programs, the platform centralizes access
examples.translation: Projetado para suportar equipes que vão de pesquisadores individuais a programas em escala empresarial, a plataforma centraliza o acesso
examples.suggested: Projetada para atender equipes que vão de pesquisadores individuais a programas em escala empresarial, a plataforma centraliza o acesso
examples.why: The participle must agree with 'a plataforma' (feminine), and 'suportar' is a calque of 'support'. 'Atender' or 'apoiar' is the natural choice.

examples.source: On-Prem (via IBM Quantum Platform API) Plan members
examples.translation: On-Prem (via API da IBM Quantum Platform)
examples.suggested: On-Prem (via API do IBM Quantum Platform)
examples.why: The product is treated as masculine everywhere else in the file ('O IBM Quantum Platform' in [14], [15], [16]), so it should be masculine here too.

examples.source: Qiskit Functions ... are abstracted services designed to accelerate algorithm discovery
examples.translation: são serviços abstratos projetados para acelerar a descoberta de algoritmos
examples.suggested: são serviços de alto nível (que abstraem a complexidade) projetados para acelerar a descoberta de algoritmos
examples.why: 'Abstracted' means the services hide the underlying complexity. 'Abstratos' reads as 'theoretical or non-concrete services'.

examples.source: Note that Open Plan users cannot submit session jobs.
examples.translation: Note que usuários do Plano Aberto não podem enviar jobs de Session.
examples.suggested: Observe que usuários do Open Plan não podem enviar jobs de Session.
examples.why: 'Open Plan' is a product name, and [28] keeps the other plan names (Premium, Flex) as they are. Translating only this one is inconsistent and makes it harder to match against the IBM UI.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The caveats that could mislead are kept intact: coupling_map is used only when target is not specified, None means the layout has not been chosen, the example handles at most 3 qubits, the interface changes stay backward compatible, and supports_* methods are reserved. The main slip is in entry [7], where "preset staged pass manager" becomes "gerenciador de passes staged predefinido", leaving the English adjective "staged" untranslated inside Portuguese syntax. A native editor would write "gerenciador de passes em estágios predefinido". There is also a small calque in [45]: "via o argumento de palavra-chave" reads more naturally as "por meio do argumento de palavra-chave".

examples.source: one of the 6 stages of a preset staged pass manager
examples.translation: um dos 6 estágios de um gerenciador de passes staged predefinido
examples.suggested: um dos 6 estágios de um gerenciador de passes em estágios predefinido
examples.why: The English adjective 'staged' is left untranslated in the middle of a Portuguese phrase, which reads like an MT artifact. The rest of the page already translates 'stage' as 'estágio'.

examples.source: This will be passed to the `run` method via the `options` keyword argument.
examples.translation: Isso será passado ao método `run` via o argumento de palavra-chave `options`.
examples.suggested: Ele será passado ao método `run` por meio do argumento de palavra-chave `options`.
examples.why: 'via o' is a stiff calque of 'via'. 'por meio do' is the natural phrasing in Portuguese technical writing.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The NoiseLearner vs NoiseLearnerV3 contrast, the Pauli-Lindblad/TREX condition and the client-side/server-side split all match the English. A few spots still read like translation. "unique layers" becomes "camadas únicas" in [10] and [29], which a reader could take as "single layers" rather than "distinct layers". "boxed circuit" becomes the stiff calque "circuito encaixotado" in [11] and [29]. In [22], "exatamente" is added to "what parameters to generate", a slight strengthening the source doesn't make.

examples.suggested: Aprenda os modelos de ruído das camadas distintas

examples.translation: a partir do circuito encaixotado
examples.suggested: a partir do circuito com caixas

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. Nothing drifts: the XY4 composing to the identity, YGate not being a basis gate while XGate is, and BasisTranslator being rerun after scheduling all match the English. The recurring defect is gender agreement on "porta", which is feminine but is repeatedly given masculine articles and adjectives: "os portas usados" [9], "os portas `ecr` ... são aplicados" [11], "portas que se compõem ... e são espaçados" [13] and "um porta de base" twice in [14] and once in [19]. A native editor would fix all of these to "as portas usadas", "uma porta de base" and so on. "Documentação da API do Transpile" [23] also reads oddly and would be better as "do transpilador" or "de transpilação".

examples.suggested: adicionar informações de temporização para as portas usadas no desacoplamento dinâmico

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing here would mislead a learner. editor_note: The meaning is accurate throughout. The BackendV2 condition, the missing built-in error mitigation and the `memory` requirement all come through intact. There are two naturalness problems. The headings in [1], [2], [5] and [9] translate "Get started with" as "Começar com …", which is a stiff calque; "Primeiros passos com …" is the natural PT heading. In [13], "Review the … API documentation" becomes "Revise a documentação", which is a false friend: in PT "revisar" means to edit or proofread, so "Consulte a documentação" is what a native writer would use.

examples.suggested: Primeiros passos com as primitivas de Backend

examples.suggested: Consulte a documentação da API ...

editor_note: The meaning is accurate throughout, including the benchmark numbers, the population_size guidance (84 qubits needs 120, 56 qubits needs 40) and the cost-distribution discussion, so nothing would mislead a learner. A few calques remain. "portfólios gerados pelo quantum" [42] and "problema compatível com quântum" [11] treat "quantum" as a noun. "fornece a análise de diferentes trajetórias" [32] mistranslates "provides for" (it means "allows", not "supplies"). The numbered step headings [18], [22] and [30] gain a trailing period that [24] and [31] don't have.

examples.suggested: 1. Leia os ativos incluídos no portfólio

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally in "você" register. UI labels are consistent, with Access management rendered as "Gerenciamento de acesso" and Delete as "Excluir", and the removal caveat in [16] ("não serão mais visíveis para ele… ainda podem acessar") keeps the same meaning as the English.

The translation is faithful overall. The cost-limit caveats in [23]–[25] and [37]–[38] keep their meaning, and "você" is used throughout. Three things need fixing. In [39], both "billing system" and "invoicing system" became "sistema de faturamento", so the sentence now says the billing system takes days to send data to itself; the second one should be "sistema de emissão de faturas". "Workload" appears as "carga de trabalho" in [3]/[4] and as the bare English "workload" in [32]/[33]. In [5], "o custo por X segundos" reads as a per-unit rate, while the English means the cost of X seconds ("para X segundos").

examples.source: The billing system can take multiple days to get information to the invoicing system
examples.translation: O sistema de faturamento pode levar vários dias para enviar informações ao sistema de faturamento
examples.suggested: O sistema de faturamento pode levar vários dias para enviar as informações ao sistema de emissão de faturas

examples.suggested: o custo de X segundos de runtime pode ser diferente

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The tensor/expand subsystem ordering, the compose vs front=True matrix order and the global-phase caveats all match the English. "Gate" is rendered two ways: as the feminine noun "porta", which gets the wrong article twice ("um porta" in [12] and [30]), and as "gates" in the same sentence in [12] and again in [17]. The files should pick one convention and fix the gender agreement. "Exception raised" is calqued as "exceção será levantada" in [12], [15] and [35], where "lançada" is the idiomatic Portuguese. The word order in [41], "é geralmente apenas uma medida válida", reads stiffly and could be misread as "merely".

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The AND-strategy caveat in [20] and the limitations paragraph in [24] are kept intact. A few calques would still bother a native editor. In [12], "small angle RX rotations" becomes "pequenas rotações RX angulares", which should be "rotações RX de ângulo pequeno". In [6], "do not confirm a flipped qubit as expected" becomes the stiff "não confirmam um qubit com flip esperado". In [9], "transpilado contra um Backend" copies English "against". editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. Every caveat in the notes survives: no parsing of variable declarations, aliased classical registers not supported on hardware, nested control flow not eligible for hardware, and gate modifiers evaluated eagerly at a possible runtime cost. editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and every removal, caveat and replacement path matches the English. editor_note: The meaning is faithful everywhere and nothing would mislead a learner. The authentication caveats in [38]/[39] and the server descriptions are all intact. "consciência contextual" in [11] is a literal calque of "contextual awareness", and "contribuídos pela comunidade" in [27] is stiff.

examples.source: through the [AI-powered transpiler passes](/guides/ai-transpiler-passes)
examples.translation: por meio das [passagens do Transpiler com IA]
examples.suggested: por meio dos [passes de transpilação com IA]
examples.why: 'Passagens' is the everyday word for passages or tickets. It is not the conventional term for compiler/transpiler passes. The same fix applies to [49].

examples.source: Generating quantum code with contextual awareness
examples.translation: Gerar código quântico com consciência contextual
examples.suggested: Gerar código quântico levando em conta o contexto
examples.why: 'Consciência contextual' is a word-for-word calque. It reads oddly because 'consciência' suggests consciousness.

examples.source: The following community-contributed MCP servers are also available:
examples.translation: Os seguintes servidores MCP contribuídos pela comunidade também estão disponíveis:
examples.suggested: Também estão disponíveis os seguintes servidores MCP mantidos pela comunidade:
examples.why: 'Contribuídos pela comunidade' is a stiff passive calque. A native technical writer would say 'da comunidade' or 'mantidos pela comunidade'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The notes caveat that the "compilation" time is NOT the billing QPU time is kept, and so are the X/Y axis descriptions and the play/capture example. A few phrasings would still get a native edit. In [21], "para comunicar quando medir qubits" can be read as "to signal when to measure", but the English means communication that happens while measuring ("ao medir qubits"). In [19], "atribuído com a instrução" is a calque, and in [18] "o qubit a operar" is stiff.

examples.source: Used by readout channels to communicate when measuring qubits.
examples.translation: Usado por canais de leitura para comunicar quando medir qubits.
examples.suggested: Usado pelos canais de leitura para se comunicarem durante a medição dos qubits.
examples.why: 'comunicar quando medir' is ambiguous and can suggest signalling *when* to measure. The source means communication that happens during measurement.

examples.source: The channel that is being assigned with the instruction.
examples.translation: O canal que está sendo atribuído com a instrução.
examples.suggested: O canal ao qual a instrução é atribuída.
examples.why: This is a calque of the English passive with 'with'. It is unidiomatic in Portuguese.

examples.source: The gate and the qubit to operate on.
examples.translation: O gate e o qubit a operar.
examples.suggested: O gate e o qubit sobre o qual ele atua.
examples.why: 'o qubit a operar' is stiff and reads as 'the qubit that will operate'. The source means the qubit that is operated on.

editor_note: Entry [14] says the 0.46.0 release comes "imediatamente após o lançamento da 1.0.0" (immediately after 1.0.0). The English "immediately proceeding" is a typo for "preceding", and the entry before it, [13], says the final minor version is published "Logo antes" (shortly before) the new major version. The Portuguese reverses the order and contradicts [13] and the upgrade advice in [15], so a learner could come away with the wrong release sequence. There is also a small terminology inconsistency: [6] uses "lançamento principal X" for "major release", but the rest of the file consistently uses "versão maior".

examples.source: For example, immediately proceeding the 1.0.0 release, a 0.46.0 release is published.
examples.translation: Por exemplo, imediatamente após o lançamento da 1.0.0, uma versão 0.46.0 é publicada.
examples.suggested: Por exemplo, imediatamente antes do lançamento da 1.0.0, é publicada uma versão 0.46.0.
examples.why: The source means 'preceding' (see [13], 'Shortly before a new major version'). 'após' reverses the order, so the example no longer matches its setup and contradicts the recommended upgrade path.

examples.source: Example of a major release X cadence:
examples.translation: Exemplo de uma cadência de lançamento principal X:
examples.suggested: Exemplo da cadência de lançamentos de uma versão maior X:
examples.why: Everywhere else in the file 'major' is rendered as 'maior' (versão maior). 'principal' breaks that consistency, and the word order is a calque of the English.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout: the Bell-state setup, the near-even 00/11 split and the three-qubit 000/111 extension all match the English, and nothing here would mislead a learner. Entry [49] swaps the linked guide's descriptive title "Run your first circuit on hardware" for a bare "[Hello world]", so the reader loses the hint about what the guide covers. Two small phrasing points remain: "assinatura do entrelaçamento quântico" [43] is a calque of "signature" that reads oddly in Portuguese, and the accordion title [14] "Clique para expandir para obter mais informações" repeats "para" and sounds stiff.

examples.source: Follow the steps in the [Run your first circuit on hardware](/guides/hello-world) guide to run a circuit on real quantum hardware.
examples.translation: Siga os passos em [Hello world](/guides/hello-world) para executar um Circuit em hardware quântico real.
examples.suggested: Siga os passos do guia [Execute seu primeiro circuito em hardware](/guides/hello-world) para executar um circuito em hardware quântico real.
examples.why: The descriptive guide title is replaced by an untranslated 'Hello world' and the word 'guia' is dropped, so the reader loses the hint about what the linked page covers.

examples.source: This result is a signature of quantum entanglement.
examples.translation: Este resultado é uma assinatura do entrelaçamento quântico.
examples.suggested: Este resultado é uma marca característica do entrelaçamento quântico.
examples.why: 'Assinatura' in this sense is a calque of the English 'signature'. 'Marca característica' or 'evidência' is the more natural choice in Portuguese technical writing.

examples.source: Click to expand for more information on **virtual environments**.
examples.translation: Clique para expandir para obter mais informações sobre **ambientes virtuais**.
examples.suggested: Clique para expandir e saber mais sobre **ambientes virtuais**.
examples.why: The repeated 'para ... para' is stiff. It is also inconsistent with the parallel title in [11], which already uses 'Clique para expandir e saber mais sobre'.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, with no drift: "distribuições de quase-probabilidade completas com mitigação de erros" keeps the full claim, "aumentar a reutilização do circuito" matches the source, and "modo de execução em lote" and "limites de job" follow the source closely.

The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The measurement caveats in [12] and [33], the "sobrecarga de amostragem"/"ruído de shot" passages and the PUB-level `precision`/`shots` explanations all match the source. Two small editorial slips remain. Section headings mix moods: "Use o Estimator de referência" and "Use o Sampler de referência" are imperative, while their siblings use the infinitive ("Inicializar o Estimator", "Executar e obter resultados"). In [27], "Isso é a sobrecarga de amostragem e é definida" is an awkward agreement calque; it should refer back to the argument rather than to "Isso".

examples.source: Use the reference Estimator
examples.translation: Use o Estimator de referência
examples.suggested: Usar o Estimator de referência
examples.why: The sibling headings use the infinitive (Inicializar, Executar, Obter, Definir), so this imperative is inconsistent. The same applies to [29].

examples.source: This is the sampling overhead and is defined exclusively in the `.run()` method.
examples.translation: Isso é a sobrecarga de amostragem e é definida exclusivamente no método `.run()`.
examples.suggested: Esse argumento representa a sobrecarga de amostragem e é definido exclusivamente no método `.run()`.
examples.why: The neuter "Isso" does not agree with the feminine "definida", and the sentence reads as a literal calque.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The stretch-resolution remainder rule, the experimental caveats and the Quantum Compute limitations (one stretch per qubit set, no negative delays) all come through intact. Entry [3] has gender-agreement errors: 'porta' is feminine, but the text says 'dos portas calibrados' and 'um porta'. A few phrases are also calqued: 'O código acima resolve para um valor de 25' and 'valor de meta', where 'valor-alvo' would be more natural.

examples.source: after the exact duration of calibrated gates are known
examples.translation: após as durações exatas dos portas calibrados serem conhecidas
examples.suggested: após as durações exatas das portas calibradas serem conhecidas
examples.why: Gender-agreement error: 'porta' is feminine, and the same sentence also uses 'um porta' where it should be 'uma porta'.

examples.source: The above code resolves to a value of 25 with a remainder of 1.
examples.translation: O código acima resolve para um valor de 25 com um resto de 1.
examples.suggested: No código acima, o stretch é resolvido com o valor 25 e resto 1.
examples.why: 'resolve para' is a calque of 'resolves to' and reads stiffly in Portuguese.

examples.source: The requested goal value.
examples.translation: O valor de meta solicitado.
examples.suggested: O valor-alvo solicitado.
examples.why: 'valor de meta' is a literal rendering; 'valor-alvo' is the idiomatic technical term. It is also used in [30].

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The caveats in [8] and [9] carry over intact: synthesis cost grows exponentially, and synthesis produces deep circuits unsuited to noisy hardware. There are two grammatical gender agreement errors: in [7] "portas quânticos" should be "portas quânticas", and in [13] "os portas usados" should be "as portas usadas". A native editor would fix both, but neither would mislead a learner.

examples.source: into a set of quantum gates
examples.translation: em um conjunto de portas quânticos
examples.suggested: em um conjunto de portas quânticas
examples.why: 'porta' is feminine, so the adjective must be 'quânticas'.

examples.source: to better visualize the gates used to re-synthesize the unitary
examples.translation: para visualizar melhor os portas usados para re-sintetizar o unitário
examples.suggested: para visualizar melhor as portas usadas para re-sintetizar o unitário
examples.why: The article and participle take masculine forms, but 'portas' is feminine.

editor_note: The translation is faithful overall, and the core terms (primitivas, transpilação, observáveis, mitigação de medição) are correct. Three spots need a fix. In [27], "nominate your own project" became "nomear seu próprio projeto", a false friend that reads as "name your own project"; it should say "indicar". In [29], "primitive interface" became "interface primitiva", which suggests a crude interface when it means the interface to the primitives ("interface das primitivas"). In [4], the service's former name was shortened from "Qiskit Runtime Service" to "Qiskit Runtime", which drops part of the actual name.

examples.source: as well as information about how to nominate your own project
examples.translation: bem como informações sobre como nomear seu próprio projeto
examples.suggested: bem como informações sobre como indicar seu próprio projeto
examples.why: 'Nomear' is a false friend. Readers will take it as 'give your project a name', not 'submit it for inclusion in the catalog'.

examples.source: Find out how to use the [primitive interface](/guides/primitives)
examples.translation: Descubra como usar a [interface primitiva](/guides/primitives)
examples.suggested: Descubra como usar a [interface das primitivas](/guides/primitives)
examples.why: 'Interface primitiva' means a rudimentary or basic interface. The source means the interface of the Sampler/Estimator primitives, which the file elsewhere calls 'primitivas'.

examples.source: IBM Quantum Compute Service (formerly known as the Qiskit Runtime Service)
examples.translation: IBM Quantum Compute Service (anteriormente conhecido como Qiskit Runtime)
examples.suggested: IBM Quantum Compute Service (anteriormente conhecido como Qiskit Runtime Service)
examples.why: The translation drops part of the product's former name. 'Qiskit Runtime' alone is a different, broader name than the service.

editor_note: Accurate and reads naturally; "gerenciador de passes em estágios predefinido", "síntese unitária" and "síntese de alto nível" are used the same way throughout, and the "tentada em sequência até que um deles tenha sucesso" caveat in [33] matches the English.

The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the teleportation test logic, the cd-to-Bell-state cases and the 85% vs 75% CHSH figures. Core terms are right and used consistently: porta, entrelaçamento, codificação superdensa, medições na base padrão, registrador clássico. A native editor would still change three things. In [21], "Sua declaração precisa" is a calque of "precise statement"; a theorem has an "enunciado". In [49], "moedas justas" is a calque of "fair coins"; the Portuguese idiom is "moedas honestas". In [20], the ironic "at the cost of an e-bit no less" loses its emphasis and becomes a plain "ao custo de um e-bit".

examples.source: Its precise statement is technical and requires explanation
examples.translation: Sua declaração precisa é técnica e requer explicação
examples.suggested: Seu enunciado preciso é técnico e requer explicação
examples.why: A theorem has an 'enunciado' in Portuguese. 'Declaração' is a calque of 'statement'.

examples.source: essentially to flip fair coins
examples.translation: essencialmente para lançar moedas justas
examples.suggested: essencialmente para lançar moedas honestas
examples.why: 'Moeda honesta' is the usual Portuguese term for an unbiased coin in probability. 'Moeda justa' is a literal calque.

examples.source: at the cost of an e-bit no less, hardly seems worth it
examples.translation: ao custo de um e-bit, mal parece valer a pena
examples.suggested: e ainda por cima ao custo de um e-bit, mal parece valer a pena
examples.why: 'No less' stresses that spending an e-bit makes the trade look even worse. The translation drops that emphasis.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout: the global-phase argument, the no-cloning proof and the orthogonality proof all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. There are grammar slips a native editor would fix. "Porta" is feminine but appears as "portas unitários" in [49] and "todos os portas unitários" in [51]. "Raciocínando" in [61] is misspelled and should be "Raciocinando". [72] has a broken construction, "calculando o produto interno ... deve resultar", and [19] has a stray comparative, "as mesmas probabilidades do que o outro". Two smaller points: "qubit do topo" reads less naturally than "qubit superior", and in [6] and [48] the comma after "ou seja" was moved inside the math delimiters ("ou seja$,\vert").

examples.source: any number of unitary gates, followed by a single standard basis measurement of the top qubit
examples.translation: qualquer número de portas unitários, seguidos por uma única medição na base padrão do qubit do topo
examples.suggested: qualquer número de portas unitárias, seguidas por uma única medição na base padrão do qubit superior
examples.why: 'Porta' is feminine, so the adjective and participle must agree. 'Qubit do topo' is a calque of 'top qubit'; 'qubit superior' is the usual phrasing.

examples.source: the combined action of all of the unitary gates in our circuit
examples.translation: a ação combinada de todos os portas unitários em nosso circuito
examples.suggested: a ação combinada de todas as portas unitárias do nosso circuito
examples.why: Gender agreement error with 'portas'.

examples.source: Reasoning similarly for |phi> in place of |psi>
examples.translation: Raciocínando de forma análoga
examples.suggested: Raciocinando de forma análoga
examples.why: Spelling error: the gerund takes no accent.

examples.source: Finally, taking the inner product of the vectors on the left-hand sides ... must result in the same zero value
examples.translation: Por fim, calculando o produto interno dos vetores nos lados esquerdos das equações (1) e (2) deve resultar no mesmo valor zero
examples.suggested: Por fim, calcular o produto interno dos vetores nos lados esquerdos das equações (1) e (2) deve resultar no mesmo valor zero
examples.why: A gerund cannot be the subject of 'deve resultar'. As written the sentence is ungrammatical.

examples.source: will produce outcomes with precisely the same probabilities as the other
examples.translation: produzirá resultados com exatamente as mesmas probabilidades do que o outro
examples.suggested: produzirá resultados com exatamente as mesmas probabilidades para ambos os estados
examples.why: 'As mesmas ... do que' mixes an equality construction with a comparative one, which is ungrammatical.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The 400-minute QPU minimum, the two-qubit depth of about 30, the eligibility caveat for Quantum Credits and the "not a faster general-purpose computer" warning all come through intact. The problems are calques and small grammar slips. English "novel" is left untranslated in "pesquisa novel" [30] and "simulação novel" [52], while [48] correctly uses "inovadoras". "Awards" is rendered as "prêmios" (prizes) in [66]/[67]/[69]/[108]. [78] has garbled phrases: "cibersegurança quântica segura" for quantum-safe security, "aprendizados" for apprenticeships and "químicos" for the chemicals industry. There are also agreement errors: "muito ênfase" [16], "dado os recursos" [9]/[34] and "é necessário mais de 400 minutos" [31].

examples.source: minimum access for novel quantum computing research requires 400 minutes
examples.translation: o acesso mínimo para pesquisa novel em computação quântica requer 400 minutos
examples.suggested: o acesso mínimo para pesquisas inovadoras em computação quântica é de 400 minutos
examples.why: 'novel' is English, not Portuguese. [48] renders the same phrase as 'pesquisas inovadoras', so the file is also inconsistent.

examples.source: quantum-safe cybersecurity skills ... industry-embedded training and apprenticeships
examples.translation: habilidades de cibersegurança quântica segura ... treinamento integrado à indústria e aprendizados
examples.suggested: habilidades de cibersegurança resistente a ataques quânticos ... treinamento integrado à indústria e programas de aprendizagem profissional
examples.why: 'Quantum-safe' means resistant to quantum attacks, and 'cibersegurança quântica segura' is garbled. 'Aprendizados' means things learned, not apprenticeships.

examples.source: NSF Quantum Awards: Search NSF awards search
examples.translation: Prêmios Quânticos NSF: Pesquise [busca de prêmios NSF]
examples.suggested: Financiamentos quânticos concedidos pela NSF: pesquise na [busca de concessões da NSF]
examples.why: In funding contexts, 'award' means a grant that has been given out. 'Prêmio' suggests a prize, which is a calque.

examples.source: There has been a lot of emphasis on the need for a quantum-smart workforce
examples.translation: Tem havido muito ênfase na necessidade
examples.suggested: Tem havido muita ênfase na necessidade
examples.why: 'Ênfase' is feminine, so it should be 'muita'. The same kind of agreement slip appears as 'dado os recursos' in [9]/[34] and 'é necessário mais de 400 minutos' in [31].

examples.source: When we allow for experimentation, benchmarking of your problem, and multiple attempts
examples.translation: Quando permitimos experimentação, benchmarking do seu problema e múltiplas tentativas
examples.suggested: Quando levamos em conta a experimentação, o benchmarking do seu problema e múltiplas tentativas
examples.why: 'Allow for' means to account for, but 'permitimos' says 'we permit'. It is a calque of the phrasal verb.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The probability claims (p < 1/2, 0<p<1/2), the syndrome tables, the no-cloning caveat and the Shor-code outlook all match the English, and the text consistently uses the informal você register. There are a few small problems a native editor would fix. Entry [61] keeps "bit flip" and "phase kickback" in English, while the rest of the file consistently says "inversão de bit". Entry [57] uses the calque "inverte entre os estados" for "flips between the states"; "alterna entre" reads better. Entry [47] drops the hedge "are assumed to occur": it states that phase-flip errors do occur independently, when the source presents this only as a modelling assumption. Entry [21] uses the calque "Para ser claro".

examples.source: compared to the bit flip check. This is related to the phase kickback phenomenon
examples.translation: em comparação com a verificação de bit flip. Isso está relacionado ao fenômeno de phase kickback
examples.suggested: em comparação com a verificação de inversão de bit. Isso está relacionado ao fenômeno de retorno de fase (phase kickback)
examples.why: Everywhere else the file renders bit-flip as 'inversão de bit', so leaving 'bit flip' in English here is inconsistent.

examples.source: flips between the states |+> and |->
examples.translation: inverte entre os estados |+> e |->
examples.suggested: alterna entre os estados |+> e |->
examples.why: 'inverter entre' is a calque of the English and is not idiomatic Portuguese. 'alternar entre' or 'troca |+> por |->' reads naturally.

examples.source: in a situation in which phase-flip errors are assumed to occur independently on each qubit
examples.translation: em uma situação em que erros de inversão de fase ocorrem independentemente em cada qubit
examples.suggested: em uma situação em que se supõe que erros de inversão de fase ocorram independentemente em cada qubit
examples.why: The translation drops the 'assumed' qualifier, so a modelling assumption reads as a statement of fact. It does not mislead materially, but the qualifier should be restored.

examples.source: To be clear, when we refer to...
examples.translation: Para ser claro, quando nos referimos...
examples.suggested: Para deixar claro, quando nos referimos...
examples.why: 'Para ser claro' is a literal calque. 'Para deixar claro' is the idiomatic Portuguese phrase.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The anti-commutation claims, the weight examples (0/2/6), the rank-2^{n-1} projections, the Bell-state non-collapse remark and the single-control-qubit argument all match the English, and core terms are consistent (observável, medição projetiva, posto, estimativa de fase, "a menos de" for "up to"). Entry [35] uses "uniquamente", which is not a Portuguese word. It should be "unicamente", or better "univocamente" or "definida de forma única". The same entry's "apenas finitos autovalores" and "apenas finitos resultados" are calques of "finitely many". A native editor would write "um número finito de autovalores" and "um número finito de resultados".

examples.source: we're associating with $A$ a certain uniquely defined projective measurement
examples.translation: estamos associando a $A$ uma certa medição projetiva uniquamente definida
examples.suggested: estamos associando a $A$ uma certa medição projetiva definida de forma única
examples.why: 'uniquamente' is not a Portuguese word; it reads as a typo or calque of 'uniquely'.

examples.source: because matrices have only finitely many eigenvalues, there will only be finitely many different measurement outcomes
examples.translation: como as matrizes têm apenas finitos autovalores, haverá apenas finitos resultados de medição possíveis
examples.suggested: como as matrizes têm apenas um número finito de autovalores, haverá apenas um número finito de resultados de medição possíveis
examples.why: 'apenas finitos X' is a stiff calque of 'finitely many'; the natural technical phrasing is 'um número finito de'.

editor_note: Entry [41] reverses which operator replaces which. "X⊗X⊗X is substituted for X" means X⊗X⊗X takes X's place, but "X⊗X⊗X é substituído por X" says X replaces X⊗X⊗X, which gets the Shor-code generator construction backwards. The rest of the page is faithful and uses consistent terminology (código estabilizador, geradores estabilizadores, espaço de código, síndrome, "a menos de" for "up to"). A native editor would still fix a few smaller things: "implicação conversa" should be "implicação recíproca", "A razão real pelas quais" is ungrammatical, and there are calques like "os geradores estabilizadores todos comutam" and "não podemos possivelmente corrigir".

examples.source: except that $X\otimes X\otimes X$ is substituted for $X$
examples.translation: exceto que $X\otimes X\otimes X$ é substituído por $X$
examples.suggested: exceto que $X$ é substituído por $X\otimes X\otimes X$
examples.why: In Portuguese, 'A é substituído por B' means B replaces A, so the direction is inverted. The generators contain X⊗X⊗X where the phase-flip code has X, not the other way around.

examples.source: The converse implication happens to be trivial
examples.translation: A implicação conversa é trivial
examples.suggested: A implicação recíproca é trivial
examples.why: 'Conversa' is a false friend here. The standard Portuguese term for the converse of a logical implication is 'recíproca'.

examples.source: The *real* reason Clifford operations are defined like this
examples.translation: A razão *real* pelas quais as operações de Clifford são definidas dessa forma
examples.suggested: A razão *real* pela qual as operações de Clifford são definidas dessa forma
examples.why: 'pelas quais' does not agree with the singular 'razão', so the sentence is ungrammatical.

examples.source: we can't possibly correct every error detected by a stabilizer code
examples.translation: não podemos possivelmente corrigir todos os erros detectados
examples.suggested: é impossível corrigir todos os erros detectados
examples.why: This copies the English 'can't possibly' word for word. A native writer would not use 'possivelmente' this way.

examples.source: The stabilizer generators all *commute* with one another.
examples.translation: Os geradores estabilizadores todos *comutam* uns com os outros.
examples.suggested: Todos os geradores estabilizadores *comutam* entre si.
examples.why: The floating 'todos' follows English word order and reads stiffly in Portuguese. The same pattern appears again in [61] and [70].

editor_note: No sentence misleads a learner, and the core terms are correct and consistent throughout: porta, meio somador/somador completo, crivo do corpo de números, medição adiada, profundidade de circuito. A native editor would still fix these: [118] renders "loose abstraction" as "abstração ampla", which means "broad" rather than "imprecise". [107] adds "clássicos" to "known algorithms", which the source does not say. [48] drops "intended to be" from "abstract proxy". [109] uses the English-style passive calque "é geralmente acreditado ... que requer". There are also small grammar slips: "executar a função ... não é razoavelmente vista" needs "visto", and "dois meio somadores" needs "dois meios somadores".

examples.source: must be understood as being a loose abstraction
examples.translation: deve ser entendida como uma abstração ampla
examples.suggested: deve ser entendida como uma abstração aproximada (ou: bastante livre)
examples.why: 'Ampla' means broad or wide. The source's point is that the abstraction is imprecise, not that it is broad.

examples.source: known algorithms for integer factorization are much more expensive
examples.translation: os algoritmos clássicos conhecidos para fatoração de inteiros são muito mais custosos
examples.suggested: os algoritmos conhecidos para fatoração de inteiros são muito mais custosos
examples.why: 'Clássicos' is not in the source. It is harmless in context but narrows the claim.

examples.source: is generally believed (but not rigorously proven) to require
examples.translation: é geralmente acreditado (mas não rigorosamente comprovado) que requer
examples.suggested: acredita-se geralmente (embora não esteja rigorosamente provado) que requer
examples.why: This calques the English passive. 'É acreditado que' is unidiomatic in Portuguese.

examples.source: is intended to be an abstract proxy for the time required
examples.translation: é uma representação abstrata do tempo necessário
examples.suggested: pretende ser uma representação abstrata do tempo necessário
examples.why: Dropping 'intended to be' turns a modeling intent into a flat claim that cost is the time.

examples.source: running the factorint function is not reasonably viewed as being an elementary operation
examples.translation: executar a função `factorint` não é razoavelmente vista como uma operação elementar
examples.suggested: executar a função `factorint` não pode razoavelmente ser visto como uma operação elementar
examples.why: The participle should agree with the infinitive subject 'executar' (masculine), not with 'função'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The promise, the OR post-processing, the deterministic 2^{n-1}+1 bound, the 2^{-k+1} error figure and the 1-vs-n Bernstein-Vazirani argument all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The main defect is grammatical gender: the feminine noun "porta" gets masculine articles in the Qiskit section ("um porta de consulta", "O porta de consulta", "do porta de consulta"), and [100] switches to "gate de consulta". There are also two inconsistencies within the file: "standard basis" is "base padrão" in [18] but "base computacional" in [66], and "phase kickback" is "retorno de fase" in [30] but left in English in [71]. The Bernstein-Vazirani figure title in [63] is still in English, even though the Deutsch-Jozsa one in [13] was translated.

examples.source: generates a quantum circuit implementing a query gate
examples.translation: gera um circuito quântico implementando um porta de consulta
examples.suggested: gera um circuito quântico que implementa uma porta de consulta
examples.why: 'porta' is feminine; the masculine article is a grammar error that recurs in [49], [51], [53] and [71].

examples.source: on the standard basis states of n qubits
examples.translation: sobre os estados da base computacional de $n$ qubits
examples.suggested: sobre os estados da base padrão de $n$ qubits
examples.why: The same English term is 'base padrão' in [18] and [23]; the switch is inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: through the phase kickback phenomenon
examples.translation: por meio do fenômeno de phase kickback
examples.suggested: por meio do fenômeno de retorno de fase
examples.why: [30] renders the same concept as 'retorno de fase'; the file should use one rendering.

examples.source: implements a query gate for the Bernstein-Vazirani problem
examples.translation: implementa um gate de consulta
examples.suggested: implementa uma porta de consulta
examples.why: Everywhere else the file uses 'porta' for gate.

examples.source: <Figure title="Bernstein-Vazirani problem">
examples.translation: <Figure title="Bernstein-Vazirani problem">
examples.suggested: <Figure title="Problema de Bernstein-Vazirani">
examples.why: The title is untranslated, while the parallel Deutsch-Jozsa figure title in [13] was translated.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through and nothing would mislead a learner. The core terms are correct and used consistently: "matrizes de densidade", "vetores de estado quântico", "autovalores", "emaranhado", and "formulação simplificada/geral". Two phrasings in entries [11] and [8] read as calques that a native editor would smooth. Entry [11] has "um aspecto criticamente importante delas" and entry [8] has "Isso não é facilmente feito".

examples.source: is a critically important aspect of them
examples.translation: é um aspecto criticamente importante delas
examples.suggested: é um aspecto de importância crucial dessas matrizes
examples.why: 'criticamente importante' copies the English adverb word for word, and the trailing 'delas' is awkward. Native technical prose would say 'de importância crucial' or 'fundamental'.

examples.source: This isn't easily done in the simplified formulation
examples.translation: Isso não é facilmente feito na formulação simplificada
examples.suggested: Isso não é fácil de fazer na formulação simplificada
examples.why: 'não é facilmente feito' copies the English passive and sounds stiff. 'não é fácil de fazer' is the idiomatic phrasing.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The Eagle and Heron claims, the timeline dates and qubit counts, and the true/false answers all match the source. A native editor would still fix a few things. Entry [42] has the Spanish/English spelling "superconductor" where Portuguese needs "supercondutor", which the file uses correctly elsewhere. "Business case" is calqued as "O caso de negócios" in [0], [6] and [19]. "Quantum-centric supercomputing" appears as "supercomputação centrada em quântica" in [30] but "centrada em computação quântica" in [49]. There are also small slips: Shor's "the lifetime of the universe" becomes "a vida útil do universo", with "might take" hardened to "levaria"; a bare "híbrida multi-cloud" in [58]; and an indicative "emergem" in [25] where the subjunctive "emergirem" belongs.

examples.source: IBM four-qubit superconducting quantum computer
examples.translation: computador quântico superconductor de quatro qubits
examples.suggested: computador quântico supercondutor de quatro qubits
examples.why: 'superconductor' is Spanish/English spelling; the Portuguese word, used elsewhere in this file, is 'supercondutor'.

examples.source: The business case for quantum computing
examples.translation: O caso de negócios para computação quântica
examples.suggested: A justificativa de negócios para a computação quântica
examples.why: 'Caso de negócios' is a literal calque of 'business case'. It also appears in [0] and [19].

examples.source: quantum-centric supercomputing
examples.translation: supercomputação centrada em quântica
examples.suggested: supercomputação centrada em computação quântica (as in [49])
examples.why: The same IBM term is rendered two different ways in this file.

examples.source: what might take a regular computer the lifetime of the universe to unravel
examples.translation: o que levaria a um computador comum a vida útil do universo para desvendar
examples.suggested: o que poderia levar a idade do universo para um computador comum desvendar
examples.why: 'Vida útil' means service life, which is the wrong idiom here, and the hedge in 'might' is dropped.

examples.source: enabling technologies such as automation, AI, and hybrid multi-cloud
examples.translation: tecnologias habilitadoras, como automação, IA e híbrida multi-cloud
examples.suggested: tecnologias habilitadoras, como automação, IA e nuvem híbrida multi-cloud
examples.why: 'Híbrida' is left as an adjective with no noun, which reads broken in Portuguese.

examples.source: as new algorithms emerge
examples.translation: à medida que novos algoritmos emergem
examples.suggested: à medida que novos algoritmos surgirem
examples.why: This clause refers to the future, so it takes the future subjunctive in Portuguese.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the Jordan-Wigner convention note ([60]-[71]) and the protein-lattice distance argument, so nothing here would mislead a learner. A few things still need fixing. [49] leaves the English word "hopefully" in the Portuguese ("podemos hopefully encontrar"). [33] uses the misspelled "seguimentos" for edges, where the rest of the file says "arestas". [31] renders "protein chain" as "cadeia de proteínas" (a chain of proteins) instead of "cadeia proteica". There are also some calques: "cadeia principal da cadeia" [37], "pegar e rodar" [87], and the clumsy "Agora é de certa forma padronizado ... definir" [61].

examples.source: we can hopefully find better outcomes in medical research
examples.translation: podemos hopefully encontrar melhores resultados na pesquisa médica
examples.suggested: esperamos encontrar melhores resultados na pesquisa médica
examples.why: The English adverb was left untranslated in the middle of a Portuguese sentence.

examples.source: result in our having two edges with an angle of approximately 109.5 degrees
examples.translation: resultariam em termos dois seguimentos com um ângulo
examples.suggested: resultariam em duas arestas com um ângulo
examples.why: 'seguimentos' is a misspelling of 'segmentos', and the file otherwise translates 'edge' as 'aresta'.

examples.source: The protein chain is represented as a series of turns
examples.translation: A cadeia de proteínas é representada como uma série de curvas
examples.suggested: A cadeia proteica é representada como uma série de curvas
examples.why: 'cadeia de proteínas' means a chain made of proteins, but the source means a single protein's amino-acid chain.

examples.source: It is now somewhat standardized ... to set
examples.translation: Agora é de certa forma padronizado em um contexto de computação quântica, e em mappers integrados ... definir
examples.suggested: Hoje é relativamente padrão, em computação quântica e em mappers integrados como o FermionicMapper do Qiskit, definir
examples.why: This copies the English sentence structure and reads stiffly in Portuguese.

examples.source: This isn't something anyone can just pick up and run with from the start
examples.translation: Isso não é algo que qualquer um pode simplesmente pegar e rodar desde o início
examples.suggested: Não é algo que alguém domina logo de cara
examples.why: 'pegar e rodar' translates the English idiom word for word, and it doesn't carry that meaning in Portuguese.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The list of misconceptions, the error correction versus mitigation distinction and the caveats about optimization and QML advantage all survive intact. There are a few small slips a native editor would fix. In [63], "preparação e leitura de estados eficientes" moves "efficient" onto the states rather than onto preparation and readout. In [15], "desfasamento" is the European form where Brazilian technical usage would say "defasagem". There are also calques in [24] ("Isso definitivamente não é o caso", "assumimos que") and [25] ("são melhor compreendidos" instead of "são mais bem compreendidos").

examples.source: under specific assumptions (such as efficient state preparation and readout)
examples.translation: sob suposições específicas (como preparação e leitura de estados eficientes)
examples.suggested: sob suposições específicas (como preparação e leitura eficientes de estados)
examples.why: The adjective now attaches to 'estados' ('efficient states'), not to the preparation and readout steps as in the English. It is a slight shift, but the caveat still comes through.

examples.source: Coherence and dephasing times (commonly referred to as $T_1$ and $T_2$)
examples.translation: Os tempos de coerência e desfasamento
examples.suggested: Os tempos de coerência e de defasagem
examples.why: 'Desfasamento' is the European Portuguese form. Brazilian quantum literature normally uses 'defasagem' for dephasing.

examples.source: This is distinctly not the case ... we are usually assuming they include all components
examples.translation: Isso definitivamente não é o caso ... geralmente assumimos que eles incluem todos os componentes
examples.suggested: Definitivamente não é assim ... geralmente pressupomos que eles incluem todos os componentes
examples.why: 'Não é o caso' and 'assumir que' are calqued from English. A native writer would use 'não é assim' and 'pressupor'.

examples.source: today's quantum computers are best understood as hybrid systems
examples.translation: os computadores quânticos de hoje são melhor compreendidos como sistemas híbridos
examples.suggested: os computadores quânticos de hoje são mais bem compreendidos como sistemas híbridos
examples.why: Standard written Portuguese uses 'mais bem' before a participle. 'Melhor compreendidos' reads as a colloquial slip in edited technical prose.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. For example, the error ordering in [28] (readout > 2-qubit > 1-qubit) is kept, and the core terms are consistent: porta, mapa de acoplamento, erros de leitura. There are two small things to fix. In [15], "para você se verificar" is an awkward calque of "check yourself", while [23] uses the natural "para você conferir". The platform name is also inconsistent: [21] keeps "IBM Quantum Platform" in English and has moved the period inside the link text, while [12] and [29] say "Plataforma IBM Quantum".

examples.source: code has been added below for you to check yourself
examples.translation: o código foi adicionado abaixo para você se verificar
examples.suggested: o código está logo abaixo para você conferir sua resposta
examples.why: 'se verificar' is a literal calque of 'check yourself'. [23] already uses the natural 'conferir'.

examples.source: Compare the result to the one shown for the device on [IBM Quantum Platform](...)
examples.translation: Compare o resultado com o exibido para o dispositivo na [IBM Quantum Platform.](...)
examples.suggested: Compare o resultado com o exibido para o dispositivo na [Plataforma IBM Quantum](...).
examples.why: This does not match 'Plataforma IBM Quantum' in [12] and [29], and the sentence's period has moved inside the link text.
